purpose: Bound the official B3 Boletim Diario do Mercado and legacy Dados Publicos trade-by-trade surfaces before any definitive DATA_GAP adjudication, without reading economics or changing any frozen family contract.

required_source_contract.required_dimension: trade/tick event-level data sufficient for frozen TICK_MICROSTRUCTURE families

official_evidence.name: B3 Cotações migration notice
official_evidence.observed: B3 states that since 2025-12-15 the information is available in Boletim Diario do Mercado under Derivativos > Derivativos de bolsa > Negocio a negocio.
official_evidence.implication: BDM is the canonical current official publication surface for this class of information, but the notice does not attest retrospective 2020-2024 tick coverage.

official_evidence.name: B3 Dados Publicos Negocio a negocio - Listados glossary
official_evidence.observed: The official glossary defines DD-MM-AAAA_NEGOCIOSAVISTA (TradeIntradayFile) as containing all trades from the trading session at trade-by-trade level, published on the following morning in a ZIP containing TXT.
official_evidence.time_semantics: HoraFechamento is documented as the trade instant in UTC-3 with HHMMSSNNN precision.
official_evidence.implication: Official B3 documentation proves that an event-level TradeIntraday schema existed from January 2020 and is semantically suitable for tick microstructure. It does not by itself prove that free physical files for every required 2020-2024 session remain retrievable today.

official_evidence.name: BDM public application
official_evidence.observed: The official B3 page embeds the public BDM application at arquivos.b3.com.br.
official_evidence.implication: The surface is official and public; historical event-level extent still requires physical qualification.

official_evidence.name: BDM derivatives summary physical sample
official_evidence.observed_win_row: WIN is present as an aggregated MINI INDICES FUTURO row with number of trades/contracts/volume.
official_evidence.observed_wdo_row: WDO is present as an aggregated MINI TAXAS DE CAMBIO FUTURO row with number of trades/contracts/volume.
official_evidence.reason: The sampled BDM summary chapter is aggregate-only and cannot be substituted for event-level tick data.

historical_extent.reason: The official glossary establishes the correct event-level schema and a January/2020 initial version, materially narrowing the problem from semantic availability to present-day physical archive retrieval. No free official physical archive has yet been proven to provide all required WIN/WDO 2020-2024 sessions.
